svg.title: ZoneFlow field wiring
svg.desc: Terminal row of the ZoneFlow rev A board, left to right: 24V~ 1 and 2, COM, COM, MV, zones 1 to 8, then 5V, FLOW, GND, RAIN, GND, AUX, GND. A Class 2 transformer feeds the two 24V~ terminals. Every valve has one wire to its zone terminal and one to the shared common wire on COM. The master valve or pump-start relay coil is between MV and the common. A flow meter uses 5V, FLOW and GND; a rain sensor uses RAIN and GND.
svg.text: Board, bottom edge, as the installer sees it (wiring cover off)
Valve common: one wire from COM to one lead of every valve, the master valve included
J3 (zones 5 to 8) is not fitted on the 4-zone build
Terminal 2 of J1 is the board's ground leg: the sensor GND terminals, the USB ground and the Qwiic ground are the same net.
Never join a sensor GND to the transformer's other wire, to COM or to any valve wire. Read the USB and earthing rules before connecting USB.
Drawn from the terminal table in hardware design section 16.1. The board prints these names behind the terminals, with Z1 to Z8 at the zones.
